items.evidence: Logged copy of the builder's own --follow bot on board 3: at tick 1001 board 3 (score 20, coin at x=5 left); at tick 1004 screen=play, board=4, texts 'Board 4 of 4', ball (-3, 1.248, 0), coins (-2,0),(2.2,0),(3.5,1.5). Never 'won'. 'roll.py --board 4' starts board 4 with ball (-3, 1.25->1.227, 0) at tick 5. The frame shows the slab, a tilted ramp slab and the 3 coins.

Board 4, right held from tick 0 (tick-by-tick --follow): x=-0.312 y=0.503, x=0.099 y=0.647, x=0.945 y=0.943; then x=1.095 y=0.976, x=1.425 y=0.968, x=1.795 y=0.862 (in flight). Side test: ball rolled to (0.37, 0.25, 1.53) and pushed -z into the ramp side (z=1). It stopped at z=1.23-1.27, y=0.25, and did not pass through. On the slope y stayed at about 0.25 above the ramp top face (for example x=0, y=0.61), so it did not sink into the ramp.

Script '0:board4+enter,1:right': coin (2.2,1.2,0) taken at tick 127-128 with the ball at x~2.0, y~0.77, still flying (score 10->20, 'coin' in sounds). My controller's 408-tick script (kept in judge-scratch/w4.script: right to tick 129, then braking and steering to (3.5,1.5)) ends screen=won, score 30, coins []. It loses one life on the way. Replaying the same script with 'play' gives an identical state.
Boards 1-4 with --board N: en 'Board N of 4', es 'Tablero N de 4', fr 'Plateau N sur 4' for every N. The board-4 frame HUD reads 'Board 4 of 4'.

Settings > Language, Right once: es; twice: fr (language=fr in state); Left goes back. In fr: title ['Roll','Commencer','Reglages','Quitter'], settings ['Volume : 8','Langue : Francais','Balle : Normale','Retour'], play ['Plateau 1 sur 4','Score : 0','Vies : 3'], paused ['En pause','Reprendre','Retour au titre'], lost ['Partie terminee',...,'Appuyez sur Entree pour revenir au titre'], won ['Vous avez gagne',...]. All French, checked in the state and in the frames. Note: the setting does not wrap (see defects).

Settings rows: Volume, Language, Ball, Back. Ball: Normal by default; Right gives Heavy, Left gives Light, and Down from Ball goes to Back. ball_kind follows (normal/heavy/light). Shown as 'Bola: Ligera' (es) and 'Balle : Lourde' (fr).

Board 2, right held from tick 0, settings ball_kind light/normal/heavy. Ball x was identical in all three (tick 41 -2.2456, 61 -1.3603, 81 -0.6045). On the tick before the strike (tick 77) ball x was -0.4962 for all three. The six crates' summed displacement 120 ticks after the strike (tick 198): light 0.035, normal 0.737, heavy 2.075.

In a settings folder I set volume 6, fr and heavy. settings.json then held all three, and a second run started with 6/fr/heavy. A run without a folder gave 8/en/normal. A hand-written old file {volume:3, language:es} loads as volume 3, es, ball_kind normal ('Bola: Normal'), and board 2 plays.

Re-ran the items that passed before. m01/m02: run and 800x480 PNG ok. m03: 4 WAVs of 0.3/0.25/0.9/0.8 s, nonzero peaks, distinct hashes. m04/m05: focus Start>Settings>Quit and back; enter starts board 1, score 0, lives 3; volume clamps 0..10; Back goes to the title. m06: es on every screen. m07: settings kept. m08: first y<=0.3 at play tick 27, back above 0.3 at 31, y=0.2499 at 600, 2 bounces. m09: +x,-x,-z,+z and coasting for 30+ ticks. m11: crates' max deviation 0.0007 over 300 ticks. m12: 2 crates moved over 1.6, ball slowed. m13: a crate leaves crates below y=-5 and 5 remain. m14: fall costs a life, 'fall' sound, ball back at the start, coins and crates kept, lives 2 carried to board 2. m15: bridge_x 1,2,1,0 at 90/180/270/360. m16: on the bridge with no input, x-bridge_x stayed within -0.11..0.24 for 260 ticks, and a ball pushed off early fell into the gap. m17 (now won at board 4): later ticks and pushes change nothing, and enter goes to the title. m18 and m19: frozen. m20: identical. m21/m22: frames ok. m24: README updated.

'play --ticks 40 --inputs 0:board4+enter --frame b4start.png --size 800x480' gives an 800x480 PNG (header checked). It shows the grey slab, a purple tilted ramp slab, the blue ball and 3 yellow coins, one of them up in the air beyond the ramp. At tick 100 the taken coin (-2,0) is no longer drawn.

CHANGES.md lists each change with its file (lib.rs build_board case 4, LAST_BOARD, coins_of y, actions.json board4, fr.json, game.json ball_kind setting, settings.json Ball button, spawn_ball masses). It also says what was checked and how, and what was wrong before.

defects: The Language setting does not wrap around: Right at French stays French and Left at English stays English. It steps en<->es<->fr in order but never cycles back.

The README's 'How it is put together' section is partly stale: it says actions.json holds the 'board2'/'board3' start words and that the strings are en.json and es.json. It does not mention board4 or fr.json there, although later lines do.
Known and unchanged: the texts of a Settings screen opened from the title still list the title's words; 'sounds' lists sounds at volume 0.

With a Light ball held against the board-2 crate wall, the ball stalls at x=-0.48 and the crates move only 0.02. This fits the rule (same acceleration, smaller mass), but the wall then cannot be passed with a Light ball by holding right.
